discussion:
Imported from role task file `tasks/section_2/section_2.2.yml` of `ansible-lockdown/Windows-2025-CIS` and Audit control `section_2/section_2.2/cis_2.2.31.yml` of `ansible-lockdown/Windows-2025-CIS-Audit`. The CIS Benchmark text is not part of this source.

No runnable check (when: not (win25cis_iis_and_web_services_installed or win25cis_adfs_installed) or win25cis_apply_generate_security_audits_on_iis_adfs); the original Ansible tasks are the fix.

steps.name: Original Ansible tasks
steps.shell:
- name: "2.2.31 | PATCH | Ensure Generate security audits is set to LOCAL SERVICE, NETWORK SERVICE"
  when: win25cis_rule_2_2_31
  tags:
    - level1-domaincontroller
    - level1-memberserver
    - automated
    - rule_2.2.31
    - patch
    - userrights
    - services
    - NIST800-171_3.1.1
    - NIST800-171_3.1.5
    - NIST800-171_3.3.8
    - NIST800-171_3.3.9
    - NIST800-53R5_AC-2
    - NIST800-53R5_AC-3
    - NIST800-53R5_AC-6
    - NIST800-53R5_AC-6_1
    - NIST800-53R5_AC-6_7
    - NIST800-53R5_AU-9_4
  block:
    - name: "2.2.31 | AUDIT | Read current Generate security audits holders"
      ansible.windows.win_shell: |
        $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
        # Cmdlets, operators and $Matches only - no .NET method calls - so this still
        # runs where PowerShell is in Constrained Language Mode. secedit must write to
        # a path that does not already exist: exporting USER_RIGHTS over an existing
        # file drops the [Unicode] header, after which Get-Content reads the UTF-16
        # export as single-byte characters and no line ever matches. secedit still
        # exits 0, so the read would silently return nothing.
        $cfg = Join-Path $env:TEMP "cis_userrights_$PID.inf"
        Remove-Item -LiteralPath $cfg -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
        secedit /export /areas USER_RIGHTS /cfg $cfg /quiet | Out-Null
        $holders = ''
        foreach ($line in Get-Content -LiteralPath $cfg) {
          if ($line -match '^SeAuditPrivilege\s*=\s*(.+)$') { $holders = $Matches[1] }
        }
        Remove-Item -LiteralPath $cfg -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
        if ($holders) {
          (($holders -split ',') | ForEach-Object { $_.TrimStart('*').Trim() } | Sort-Object) -join ','
        } else {
          ''
        }
      changed_when: false
      check_mode: false
      register: discovered_2_2_31_current

    - name: "2.2.31 | PATCH | Set Generate security audits to LOCAL SERVICE, NETWORK SERVICE, RESTRICTED SERVICES PrintSpoolerService"
      when:
        - not (win25cis_iis_and_web_services_installed or win25cis_adfs_installed) or win25cis_apply_generate_security_audits_on_iis_adfs
        - discovered_2_2_31_current.stdout | trim != 'S-1-5-19,S-1-5-20,S-1-5-99-216390572-1995538116-3857911515-2404958512-2623887229'
      ansible.windows.win_user_right:
        name: SeAuditPrivilege
        users:
          - LOCAL SERVICE
          - NETWORK SERVICE
          - S-1-5-99-216390572-1995538116-3857911515-2404958512-2623887229
        action: set

    - name: "2.2.31 | AUDIT | Ensure Generate security audits is set to LOCAL SERVICE, NETWORK SERVICE | IIS or ADFS installed warning"
      when:
        - win25cis_iis_and_web_services_installed or win25cis_adfs_installed
        - not win25cis_apply_generate_security_audits_on_iis_adfs
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg:
          - "Warning!! IIS or ADFS is installed on this host. CIS notes 2 and 3 for 2.2.31 require an exception so that IIS"
          - "application pools and the ADFS service accounts keep Generate security audits, so 2.2.31 is skipped on this host."
          - "Grant the exception manually, or set win25cis_apply_generate_security_audits_on_iis_adfs to true to apply the baseline anyway."

    - name: "2.2.31 | AUDIT | Ensure Generate security audits is set to LOCAL SERVICE, NETWORK SERVICE | Set warning count"
      when:
        - win25cis_iis_and_web_services_installed or win25cis_adfs_installed
        - not win25cis_apply_generate_security_audits_on_iis_adfs
      ansible.builtin.import_tasks:
        file: warning_facts.yml
      vars:
        warn_control_id: '2.2.31'
